title: Cross-process race between real 1v1 Discord Accept handler and invitation expiry sweeper
priority: P1 — a real duel:accept component delivered at deadline-1ms must race safely with the 120-second sweeper at the exact deadline.

design.isolation: Temporary SQLite; independent Node processes and connections; parent database connection closed before the race.
design.concurrency: Three races: handleDuelComponent(duel:accept) at deadline-1ms versus duelStore.expireDueDuels at deadline.
design.clock: Deterministic per-process Date.now with explicit sweeper deadline; idempotent sweeper retry reconciles a transient lock conflict.

assertions: Accept either commits a playing DuelState or fails closed after expiry; sweeper never throws an unhandled error
the final invitation revision advances exactly once
playing outcome has two physical locks, a two-player state and one private success acknowledgement
expired outcome has null state and zero physical locks
players, player_cards, starter_grants, decks and deck_cards remain unchanged
limitations: Handlers Discord.js reais executados offline com interações falsas; sem token, gateway ou guild real.
SQLite temporário e relógios determinísticos; não mede latência de produção.
